Royal Enfield had a bunch of exciting reveals at EICMA this year including the all-new Continental GT 750, Flying Flea S6 in production form and a Shotgun 650 special edition alongside its recently revealed Himalayan 750. Rishaad Mody tells you everything you need to know.
